direct_dependency_resolution.method: Read-only SQLite joins from initial fixture databases; source symbol must match the declared primary method, dependency reference and target path.

diagnosis: Refined and previous quality is identical here because every inspection prompt has no preferred source role and unchanged lexical focus token set; the new ranking heuristics do not activate.

All eight refined revoke primary-body misses already have a covering search candidate within the first forty. Four documentation pages survive focus selection while the primary source and required helpers do not.

Refined has twenty-eight missing dependency bodies: twenty-six required files absent and two present with a different or partial body. Every missing dependency has a covering candidate within the first forty. Sixteen tasks show budget omissions and sixteen show focus omissions.

All eight exact-path extend contexts include three service files from other domains. Code inspection of the initial selector found basename identifier anchoring in addition to qualified path anchoring, consistent with excess cross-domain expansion.
Release prompts say the rule it calls; the initial broad-query calls heuristic bypasses four-file focus. These eight contexts average 16.75 files and all have budget omissions.

All forty-eight declared direct dependencies have the correct resolved graph edge. These observations support selection, anchoring and packing as the failures; they do not support unresolved graph edges as the main cause.
proposed_followups_not_measured_claims: Guard narrowed context selection when implementation intent is unknown, preserving source recall before claiming selectivity gains.
Treat a qualified path as a specific module anchor rather than preserving every matching basename.
Distinguish a request for direct helper evidence from a broad search for all callers.
Prioritize complete source plus resolved direct helper bundles ahead of optional overlapping documentation and unrelated modules, then validate on a newly authored independent corpus.
limitations: Procedural visible synthetic holdout, not production representativeness; twelve mirrored language intents are correlated.
Counterfactual causes are inferred from retained candidates, exact source evidence, omission warnings and initial code inspection; no isolated causal ablation was run for this diagnosis.
Direct dependency judgments cover only two declared helpers per task; neither exact body inclusion nor all-body acceptance proves semantic coding-task completeness.
Any replay after these misses is reused validation. Initial evidence remains valid for its frozen source but does not attest a later source revision.
No model calls, actual token/cost measurement or coding-task success is supplied by these local retrieval observations.
